hf:timm/mobilenetv3_small_100.lamb_in1k.summary_en: MobileNetV3-Small 100 is a lightweight convolutional neural network optimized for mobile and edge devices. It uses inverted residual blocks with linear bottlenecks and squeeze-and-excitation modules for efficient computation. The model was trained on ImageNet-1k dataset using LAMB optimizer and achieves competitive accuracy while maintaining low computational requirements. This implementation is available in PyTorch format with safetensors.

hf:sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v.summary_en: All-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a sentence embedding model that converts text into dense vector representations. hf:google-bert/bert-base-uncased.summary_en: BERT-Base Uncased is a foundational transformer model for natural language processing tasks. hf:google/electra-base-discriminator.summary_en: Google ELECTRA-base-discriminator is a pre-trained language model using the ELECTRA framework. It employs a replaced token detection pre-training method where a generator replaces tokens and a discriminator identifies replacements. The model supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it provides base discriminator weights for natural language understanding tasks and transformer-based processing.

hf:openai/clip-vit-base-patch32.summary_en: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32 is a vision-language model developed by OpenAI that connects images and text. It uses a Vision Transformer architecture with patch size 32 and is trained on 400 million image-text pairs. The model enables zero-shot image classification by comparing image features with text descriptions. It supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, and is compatible with Transformers library. Based on research from papers arXiv:1908.04913 and arXiv:2103.00020.

hf:FacebookAI/roberta-large.summary_en: RoBERTa-Large is a large-scale language model developed by Facebook AI, optimized from BERT architecture. hf:sentence-transformers/paraphrase-mult.summary_en: This multilingual sentence embedding model generates semantic representations for text in over 50 languages. github:d3/d3.summary_en: D3.js is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. It uses web standards like SVG, Canvas, and HTML to bring data to life through charts, graphs, and other visual representations. The library provides powerful data-driven transformations of the Document Object Model, enabling developers to bind arbitrary data to DOM elements and apply data-driven transformations. It emphasizes web standards and provides capabilities for complex visualization techniques while maintaining full control over the final visual output.

github:mrdoob/three.js.summary_en: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser. It uses WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, and SVG renderers to create 3D scenes that run in browsers without plugins. The library supports various 3D features including geometries, materials, lights, cameras, and animations. It enables development of 3D applications, games, data visualizations, and virtual/augmented reality experiences that can run directly in web browsers across different devices and platforms.

github:axios/axios.summary_en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript that works in both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handling responses. The library supports all modern browsers and includes features like request and response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, client-side protection against XSRF, and the ability to cancel requests. It simplifies working with REST APIs and other HTTP services by providing a clean, promise-based interface that handles common HTTP operations and error handling scenarios.

github:excalidraw/excalidraw.summary_en: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard tool for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches.
